title: Promiscuously
summary: PROMIS'CUOUSLY, adverb In a crowd or mass without order; with confused mixture; indiscriminately; as men of all classes promiscuously assembled; particles of different earths promiscuously united. 1.

inlines.v: PROMIS'CUOUSLY, adverb In a crowd or mass without order; with confused mixture; indiscriminately; as men of all classes promiscuously assembled; particles of different earths promiscuously united. 1. Without distinction of kinds. Like beasts and birds promiscuously they join.
